chunks: If We remove the torment a little, you revert back (to misdeeds).
ai.seo_question: Why was the punishment on the people of Makkah temporary according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological state of the disbelievers of Makkah, illustrating that their repentance was merely a pragmatic response to immediate distress rather than sincere spiritual awakening. The phrase 'we will remove the punishment slightly' (kashifu al-adhab qaleelan) suggests a temporary respite to test their consistency, confirming that without true faith, they would inevitably revert to their arrogance. This reflects the broader Quranic theme that divine punishment is often calibrated to reveal the inner truth of the human heart.
